question: What happens to one who knows the Lord as world-lord?
premises: One who knows him as unborn and beginningless is undeluded.
He knows the Lord as great lord of the world.
Such a one is freed from all sins among mortals.
inference: Knowing the Lord as world-lord frees the undeluded mortal from all sins.
uncertainties: The fused token māmajamanādiṃ compresses several words.
plain_english: Whoever knows me as unborn, beginningless, and great lord of the world, being undeluded, is freed from all sins among mortals.
